title: Ask Riyad
subtitle: Pick a question below
greeting: Hi! I'm Riyad's portfolio assistant. Choose a question and I'll answer it.

items.question: Who are you?
items.answer: I'm MD. Fazle Rabbi Riyad, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I build dependable APIs, data systems, and the frontends that sit on top of them.

items.question: What's your tech stack?
items.answer: Mostly Python (Django, DRF, FastAPI) on the backend and React.js on the frontend, backed by PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis. For async work I use Celery, Kafka, WebSocket and Django Channels.

items.question: Do you handle deployment?
items.answer: Yes. I containerise services with Docker, set up CI/CD pipelines, and deploy to AWS or VPS servers behind Nginx and Gunicorn.

items.question: Competitive programming?
items.answer: I've solved 550+ problems on Codeforces with a highest rating of 1182, practice on LeetCode, and served on the organizing committee of the 2022 ICPC Asia Dhaka Regional Contest.

items.question: Are you available?
items.answer: I'm currently available for select projects. If you have something in mind, tell me about it on the [Let's talk page](/lets-talk).

items.question: How can I reach you?
items.answer: You can reach me by email at [riyad.cse27@gmail.com](mailto:riyad.cse27@gmail.com) or chat with me on [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/8801612168868). You can also send me a message from the [Let's talk page](/lets-talk).
